basic_details.job_title: Mizoram PSC Junior Scientific Officer Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 12 Posts
basic_details.department: Directorate of Forensic Science Laboratory, Home Department
basic_details.short_information: The Mizoram Public Service Commission (MPSC) has released Advertisement No.18 of 2026-27, dated 24th July 2026, inviting online applications for the post of Junior Scientific Officer (JSO) under the Directorate of Forensic Science Laboratory, Home Department, Government of Mizoram. A total of 12 vacancies are on offer across seven forensic specializations. Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the Commission's portal. This article covers the complete MPSC JSO Recruitment 2026 notification, including vacancy details, eligibility criteria, age limit, pay level, required doc

important_dates.raw: Date of Notification: 24th July 2026 Online Application Start: Not specified in the notification Last Date to Submit Online Application: 27th August 2026, up to 4:00 PM Exam Date: Not specified in the notification | Candidates who have not yet completed One-Time Registration (OTR) on the MPSC portal are advised to register well ahead of the closing date, since the notification cautions that applicants must register and submit their application well in advance of the last date.

application_fee.details: The exact application fee amount is not specified in the notification. It only states that if payment is made through UPI, it must be done using the mobile number registered for One-Time Registration (OTR), that persons with disabilities (PwD) are exempted from payment of the application fee, and that fees once paid are non-refundable under any circumstances.

age_limit.details: A candidate must not be less than 18 years and not more than 30 years of age as on 1st August 2026. The upper age limit is relaxable by up to 5 years for ST/SC candidates, or as may be notified by the Government from time to time. Accepted proof of age documents are HSLC/HSSLC Certificates, Voters ID, or Digitised Birth Certificate. | A candidate must achieve the pass mark in the qualifying test of Mizo Language Proficiency as prescribed by the Government from time to time. However, a candidate who studied Mizo as a subject in Class-X (HSLC) or above within Mizoram, or who opted for Mizo as MIL outside Mizoram, is exempted from taking this qualifying test paper, as per Mizoram Gazette Notification No. A-11019/1/2021-P&AR(GSW) dated 09.04.2024 (Issue No. 247).

qualification.details: For all seven posts, working experience in a recognized forensic science laboratory is listed as desirable (not mandatory).

salary_details.details: Selected candidates will be placed at Level - 7 in the Pay Matrix. The exact monthly pay range in rupees is not specified in the notification.

selection_process: The notification states that a Direct Recruitment Examination for the post will be conducted by the Mizoram Public Service Commission
and that the syllabus for the examination is available for download on the Commission's official website. A detailed
stage-wise selection process (such as whether it involves a preliminary exam
and/or interview) is not specified in this notification. Candidates are advised to check the syllabus link and the Commission's website for further details.
how_to_apply: Visit the MPSC online application portal at https://mpsconline.mizoram.gov.in.
Complete One-Time Registration (OTR) if not already registered.
Log in and fill in the application form for the Junior Scientific Officer (JSO) post, selecting the specific division applied for.
Upload all mandatory supporting documents listed above in the correct fields.
Pay the application fee, if applicable, through the prescribed mode (UPI payment must use the mobile number linked to OTR).
Verify that the application has actually been submitted after payment is made - the notification warns that unverified submissions will not be entertained.
Submit the application well before the last date of 27/08/2026, 4:00 PM.
important_instructions: Documentary support for eligibility must not be dated later than the last date for submission of application, and must be uploaded by that date. Candidature will be assessed based solely on the documents uploaded on the online portal. Any request to alter already-uploaded documents must be made well before the last date so the change takes effect in time; alterations made after the last date will not be considered. Failure to upload any mandatory document by the closing date will result in rejection of the application. Canvassing, directly or indirectly, by a candidate will disqualify their candidature. Incomplete or incorrect particulars in the application may lead to rejection. Any candidate found, on verification at any stage, not to fulfil the eligibility conditions will be disqualified at that stage. Candidates found guilty of misconduct or use of unfair means may be debarred from MPSC examinations, and such debarment may be shared with/recognised by UPSC and other State Public Service Commissions. Government servants are advised to apply through the proper channel. Any additional information regarding this recruitment will be published on the Commission's official website.

Candidates preparing for this recruitment can also explore other M.Sc. Forensic Science Government Jobs and M.Sc. Science Government Jobs across India. Those specifically interested in opportunities within the state can check more Mizoram Government Jobs and other Northeast India Government Jobs. content_sections.heading: MPSC Junior Scientific Officer Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The Mizoram Public Service Commission (MPSC) has officially released dated 24/07/2026 for the recruitment of 12 Junior Scientific Officer (JSO) posts under the Directorate of Forensic Science Laboratory, Home Department, Government of Mizoram . The notification provides complete details regarding discipline-wise vacancies, educational qualifications, age limit, pay level, Mizo language proficiency requirement, selection process, required documents, important instructions, and the online application procedure. content_sections.heading: MPSC JSO Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The 12 JSO vacancies are distributed across seven forensic disciplines as follows: Category-wise or reservation-wise (UR/SC/ST/OBC) break-up of these posts is not specified in the notification.

content_sections.heading: MPSC JSO Recruitment 2026 - Job Profile
content_sections.text: Selected Junior Scientific Officers will conduct scientific examination and analysis of forensic exhibits in their respective division (DNA, Fingerprint, Chemistry, Ballistics & Toolmarks, Questioned Documents, Photography, Cyber Forensics). Duties also include attending crime scenes for identification, documentation, collection and preservation of evidence (especially for DNA and Fingerprint divisions), maintaining chain of custody, operating relevant forensic instruments and techniques, preparing scientific reports, assisting investigating agencies, and deposing as an expert witness in courts.

content_sections.heading: MPSC JSO Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: For all seven posts, working experience in a recognized forensic science laboratory is listed as desirable (not mandatory).

M.Sc. Forensic Science OR M.Sc. Chemistry OR M.Sc. Biochemistry from a recognised University or Institute
M.Sc. Forensic Science OR M.Sc. Physics OR M.Sc. Mathematics/Applied Mathematics OR B.E. (Civil/Mechanical) from a recognised University or Institute
M.Sc. Forensic Science from a recognised University or Institute
M.Sc. Forensic Science (specialization in Digital/Multimedia Forensics) OR B.E./B.Tech. or above in Computer Science or Electronics from a recognised University or Institute

M.Sc. (Cyber/Digital Forensics) OR M.Sc. Forensic Science (specialization in Digital/Cyber/Multimedia Forensics) OR B.Tech. or above in Cyber/Digital Forensics OR MCA/M.Sc. IT OR B.E. and above in Computer Science from a recognised University or Institute

content_sections.heading: MPSC JSO Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: A candidate must not be less than 18 years and not more than 30 years of age as on 1st August 2026. The upper age limit is relaxable by up to 5 years for ST/SC candidates, or as may be notified by the Government from time to time. Accepted proof of age documents are HSLC/HSSLC Certificates, Voters ID, or Digitised Birth Certificate. A candidate must achieve the pass mark in the qualifying test of Mizo Language Proficiency as prescribed by the Government from time to time. However, a candidate who studied Mizo as a subject in Class-X (HSLC) or above within Mizoram, or who opted for Mizo as MIL outside Mizoram, is exempted from taking this qualifying test paper, as per Mizoram Gazette Notification No. A-11019/1/2021-P&AR(GSW) dated 09.04.2024 (Issue No. 247).

content_sections.heading: MPSC JSO Recruitment 2026 - Required Documents
content_sections.text: Candidates must upload the following documents on the online portal before the closing date: Marksheets of HSLC and above Educational Certificates of HSLC and above Proof of Computer Proficiency Proof of Mizo Language Proficiency SC/ST Certificate (for SC/ST candidates only) Proof of date of birth Proof of educational qualification relevant to the post applied for Any other supporting document, to be uploaded in the "Others" box/field of the OTR page (multiple documents can be uploaded here) Where a document type on the OTR profile page requires both a certificate and its accompanying marksheet, both must be scanned together into a single PDF, or photographed together clearly, before uploading. Uploaded documents must not be protected/locked in any way that prevents viewing or printing - a protected file will be treated as not uploaded.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MPSC JSO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 27th August 2026, up to 4:00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in MPSC JSO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 12 vacancies in total, spread across JSO (DNA), JSO (Fingerprint), JSO (Chemistry), JSO (Ballistics & Toolmarks), JSO (Questioned Documents), JSO (Photography), and JSO (Cyber Forensic).

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for MPSC JSO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 30 years of age as on 1st August 2026, with up to 5 years of age relaxation for ST/SC candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for MPSC JSO posts?
faq.answer: Qualifications vary by division and generally require an M.Sc. in Forensic Science or a related science/engineering discipline (such as Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or Cyber/Digital Forensics), depending on the specific post. See the eligibility table above for post-wise details.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay scale for MPSC Junior Scientific Officer?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be placed at Level – 7 in the Pay Matrix. The exact monthly pay figure is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for MPSC JSO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify the exact fee amount. It clarifies that UPI payment must use the OTR-registered mobile number, PwD candidates are exempted from the fee, and fees are non-refundable once paid.

faq.question: Q7. Is Mizo Language Proficiency compulsory for all candidates?
faq.answer: Candidates must generally pass the Mizo Language Proficiency qualifying test, but those who studied Mizo as a subject in Class-X (HSLC) or above within Mizoram, or as MIL outside Mizoram, are exempted from this test.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for MPSC JSO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through mpsconline.mizoram.gov.in after completing One-Time Registration (OTR), by filling the form and uploading all mandatory documents before the closing date.
